claim_text: A two-layer MLP dynamics model trained on 2000 uniformly-random Pendulum-v1 transitions supports random-shooting MPC that reaches a mean episode return of -210.
method: random-shooting receding-horizon MPC over a learned MLP forward dynamics model
conditions: 2000 uniformly-random transitions in the training buffer
MLP with two hidden layers of 200 units, Adam at lr 1e-3, 100 epochs, batch size 256
MPC horizon 15, 500 candidate action sequences, replanning every step
mean over 5 evaluation episodes of 200 steps, averaged over seeds 0, 1, 2
